entries.basis: All31external action references resolve to seven reviewed immutable commits; two candidate-local reusable workflows remain relative. Official commit/action/package/tag/release or pinned-changelog metadata is reviewed without conflating package.version with action tag identity. The maintained guard now rejects mutable external refs and local@ref forms, with14passing tests. Official checksum-verified actionlintv1.7.12 passes all four workflows without suppressions;3artifact-helper tests pass. Workflow hashes remain unchanged, preserving production/dev paths, credentials, release prerequisites, sandbox and draft-only behavior.
entries.criterion: - [ ] A-R-25 Reconcile original `R-25`: Pin/review workflow dependencies according to repository policy and validate proposed workflow changes without weakening protections to make checks pass. Historical status: open.

limits: Reference form and source review do not certify upstream safety or immutable downloaded tools. Optional Codex CLI version and floating hosted Node/Ubuntu boundaries remain explicit. No new live Actions, AI PR, effective branch-protection, release, main, tag or publication success inferred; R21/R23/R27 and release authority scopes remain separate.
